sourceOccurrences.label: Specified walks, independent alternatives and finite parallel routes
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Complete grouped source contracts with a heterogeneous finite-model extension
sourceOccurrences.note: 9IPM uses the set of distinct walk bonds and does not require a simple walk. 8V8H factors the failure events over pairwise disjoint deterministic bond sets; shared vertices are permitted. Both retain the source arbitrary-vertex scope as outer-measure inequalities. YPNG specializes to the source homogeneous complete bipartite graph with two endpoints and k middle vertices, while its separate heterogeneous formulation and arbitrary loop probabilities are elementary extensions. The adjacency-closed-set argument covers the source deterministic reachability helper. No formal status or reviewed correspondence is authored.

sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected statement correspondence with additional deductions identified
sourceOccurrences.note: The deleted-configuration endpoint characterization and shortest-open-path bound are deterministic on arbitrary vertices. The counting bound requires a realized connection and uses open-graph distance. Diagonal and noninternal pairs are excluded for internal connection; restriction commutes with forcing an internal pair.

proofUses.reason: A finite open walk connects its endpoints, and independence gives the finite-cylinder product.
Each walk event implies connection; independence of disjoint coordinate blocks factors all the failure probabilities.
The lower-bound event is the entire connection event on the finite parallel host, as shown by the adjacency-closed set.
Uses the existing forcing, block-independence, finite derivative or graph restriction results with their stated scopes.
